study_identification_part.si_4_title: Individual-level deviations from normative brain morphology in violence, psychosis, and psychopathy

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: TOP (Thematically Organized Psychosis), sTOP (Forensic Psychiatry study), uTOP (Youth-TOP study), and STROKEMRI (Stroke MRI study) were the primary sources for the local participants (calibration and clinical samples). A pre-trained normative model was used, which was trained on 58,835 individuals from 82 sites (Rutherford et al., 2022).
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: Participants (n = 782 male/608 female) were recruited from the Oslo area as part of four studies: the Thematically Organized Psychosis study (TOP), the STROKEMRI study, The Youth-TOP study (uTOP), and The Forensic Psychiatry study (sTOP). ...
